newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's Summers touts support for strong dlr.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's Summers touts support for strong dlr.

text.p: U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers reiterated his support for a strong dollar on Monday.
Summers, in an interview with CNBC, said the U.S. policy towards the dollar remains unchanged.
"We believe in a strong dollar," Summers said. "We believe a strong dollar is in the country's interests."

Summers pointed out that a strong dollar means higher real wages, more purchasing power for American workers, translating into a more stable economic environment. Plus, he said a strong dollar results in a low capital costs because the greenback has a central role in the global financial system as the world's reserve currency.
"All those things make a strong dollar in the United States' interest," Summer said. "That's been our policy for a long time and will continue to be our policy."
